keysForContent.splitPaymentConsent1: I do hereby declare that I have received a loan from CreditAccess Grameen Ltd. To secure the said loan, I have availed a Group Micro life insurance cover under the master insurance policy of CreditAccess Grameen Ltd. I hereby assign my rights and benefits of the said Group Micro life insurance cover, subsequent to its issuance, to the extent of outstanding loan amounts as per loan schedules payable to CreditAccess Grameen Ltd. on the date of occurrence of the contingent event. This assignment will be governed by the terms and conditions of this assignment and Section 38 of the Insurance Act, 1938 as amended from time to time. I hereby agree and confirm that I shall inform my beneficiary/ nominee about the existence of this assignment
